8396162: RISC-V: Optimize ZGC stores of constant null

Associate both TestZGCStoreNull variants with the newly created JBS enhancement. This follow-up only adds jtreg bug metadata; implementation and runtime behavior are unchanged.

RISC-V: Optimize ZGC stores of constant null

Add constant-null C2 store rules for ordinary and Zalasr release stores. Load the relocatable ZGC good color directly while preserving the old-reference barrier and store ordering. Add functional and IR coverage.

Based on upstream master 6cf31a5e10084bd171a63908deb8bfce7443e448. Fastdebug and release ADLC generation pass on this base; full build and runtime validation on this base remain pending. Earlier-base functional, IR and microbenchmark results are recorded separately. JBS tracking issue pending.
